descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating Eden (עֵדֶן), the primordial garden of God described in Genesis 2-3 and referenced prophetically in Isaiah, Ezekiel, and Joel as the archetype of divine blessing and fertility. All multilingual glosses identify the same place: eng 'Eden / in-Eden / like-Eden', spa 'Eden / en-Eden / como-Eden', arb 'عَدْن / في-عَدْن / كـ-عَدْن', kor '에덴 / 에덴같이', swa 'Edeni / kama-Edeni'. S122573 ('like Eden') uses a comparative preposition but still refers to the same toponym as referent of the simile.
